Aaron Hickey.note: Hickey is defensive cover for Scotland's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.

Andy Robertson.note: Robertson is in the quiet-work part of Scotland's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Andy Robertson.noteZh: 他是Scotland主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Angus Gunn.summary: Angus Gunn is a Scotland goalkeeper who most recently played for Nottingham Forest and has been Scotland's first-choice keeper during the 2026 World Cup.
Angus Gunn.note: Gunn has been Scotland's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Angus Gunn.noteZh: 他给Scotland提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Craig Gordon.note: Gordon is goalkeeper cover for Scotland. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Craig Gordon.noteZh: 他是Scotland门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Dominic Hyam.note: Hyam gives Scotland another trusted body for the awkward minutes. One clean decision can keep the match from tilting.
Dominic Hyam.noteZh: 他给Scotland那些尴尬分钟多一个可信选择。一次干净决定，就能避免比赛倾斜。

Findlay Curtis.note: Curtis gives Scotland midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Findlay Curtis.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Scotland来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

George Hirst.note: Hirst is the forward Scotland can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
George Hirst.noteZh: 他给Scotland替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Grant Hanley.note: Hanley is defensive rotation for Scotland. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Grant Hanley.noteZh: 他是Scotland艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Jack Hendry.note: Hendry has been part of Scotland's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Jack Hendry.noteZh: 他在Scotland体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

John McGinn.note: McGinn has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Haiti. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
John McGinn.noteZh: 他已经为Scotland进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

John Souttar.note: Souttar is back-line insurance for Scotland. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
John Souttar.noteZh: 他给Scotland那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Kenny McLean.note: McLean gives Scotland a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Kenny McLean.noteZh: 他是Scotland的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Lewis Ferguson.note: Ferguson gives Scotland structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
